cover.main: WHERE SOUTH FLORIDA IS GOING OUT THIS WEEKEND

photo.query: South Florida concert crowd at night with arena lights
photo.prompt: dramatic nighttime crowd scene outside a South Florida arena, bright stage lights spilling out, people heading in, palm trees visible

slides.headline: Don Omar at Kaseya Center
slides.body: Sunday, Oct. 4 at 7 p.m. at Kaseya Center in Miami. Tickets run $266 to $569. Brightline is running late-night trains after the show.

photo.query: Don Omar concert stage in arena
photo.prompt: reggaeton concert stage in a packed arena with red lights, smoke, and a performer at center stage

slides.headline: Mariachi El Bronx at Revolution Live
slides.body: Sunday, Oct. 4 at 7 p.m. at Revolution Live in Fort Lauderdale. Tickets cost $38.50.

photo.query: Revolution Live Fort Lauderdale concert crowd
photo.prompt: night photo of a live concert crowd inside a club venue, stage lights in orange and blue, phones up, dense audience

slides.headline: James Turrell's Blue Sea Sky at Superblue Miami
slides.body: On view this week at Superblue Miami in Miami. Access requires a complimentary on-site reservation.

photo.prompt: immersive color-installation room with glowing blue and orange light, visitors standing inside and looking at the walls

slides.headline: Caught in the Eye at the Museum of Miami
slides.body: On view this week through April 11, 2027, at the Museum of Miami in Miami. Admission costs $8 to $15.

photo.prompt: museum gallery photo with archival hurricane photos and display cases, visitors reading wall text under soft lighting

slides.headline: Jekyll & Hyde at Actors’ Playhouse
slides.body: It opens Wednesday, Oct. 7 at the Miracle Theatre in Coral Gables. Tickets cost $40 to $100.

photo.query: Miracle Theatre Coral Gables marquee at night
photo.prompt: night exterior of the Miracle Theatre in Coral Gables with a bright marquee and people arriving for a show

caption:
South Florida has concerts, theater, and museum stops all week.
